sentences.text: Naresh Kumar vs . State Of Hp on 19 September, 2023

Author: Sushil Kukreja
Bench: Sushil Kukreja
 Naresh Kumar Vs. State of Hp
 Cr. Revision No.76 of 2023
 .
Present: Mr. Karan Singh Kanwar, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. Raj Kumar Negi, Additional Advocate General, for the respondent.

By way of the instant application, the applicant-
petitioner has prayed for suspension of sentence.

rt Learned counsel for the petitioner stated that during trial, the applicant-petitioner was on bail and during first appeal also, he was on bail and was not taken into custody after disposal/decision of the appeal.

The applicant-petitioner was convicted and sentenced by the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate Sirmaur District at Nahan, for commission of the offences under Section 39(1) A of H.P.
Excise Act, Section 420 of IPC & Sections 181, 192 & 196 of Motor Vehicles Act, vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 06.06.2018.

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate Sirmaur District at Nahan
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
However, the learned Sessions Judge, Sirmaur District at Nahan, H.P. had modified the aforesaid judgment of conviction/order of sentence passed by the learned trial Court, as while maintaining the conviction under Section 39(1)(A) of HP Excise Act and Sections 181, 192 & 196 of Motor Vehicles Act, the conviction/order of sentence under Section 420, IPC was set aside and the applicant-petitioner was convicted/sentenced under Section 482, IPC, vide .
judgment dated 11.11.2022.

entities.text: Sessions Judge, Sirmaur District at Nahan
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Therefore, the substantive sentence imposed upon the applicant-petitioner by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sirmaur District at Nahan, vide judgment of conviction/order of sentence dated of 06.06.2018 and modified by the learned Sessions Judge, Sirmaur District at Nahan, H.P. vide judgment dated rt 11.11.2022, shall remain suspended till final disposal of the petition, subject to the applicant's furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of learned trial Court and also depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, within a period of four weeks from today,
undertaking therein to appear in the Court as and when directed and in the event of the dismissal of Naresh Kumar vs . State Of Hp on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134852995/
1 the petition, the applicant-petitioner will surrender before the Court to undergo sentence, if any,
imposed by the Court.
